section_summary: This section continues a historical report on Japanese political movements, completing its discussion of socialist unity and factionalism before presenting appendices on proletarian and nationalist parties. The appendices trace party foundations, mergers, platforms, leaders, election results, splits and dissolutions from the 1920s through 1940. The final page begins an account of the Great Japan Youth Party that continues beyond this section.

subfiles.title: Left Wing–Right Wing: appendices on proletarian and nationalist parties
subfiles.about: A historical survey of Japanese socialist, labor, agrarian, nationalist and national socialist political organizations.
subfiles.summary: The report closes its analysis of socialist factionalism and postwar democratic prospects. Appendix I gives histories, officers, platforms, electoral results and mergers of major proletarian parties and the Labor-Farmer Group. Appendix II begins comparable histories of nationalist and national socialist parties, ending mid-account of the Great Japan Youth Party.
